thread:
zoe_cs: Heads-up — NovaMeds onboarding spike overnight. Billing-bot alerted us. Need quick decision on preemptive credit buffer and QBR talking points.

mike_support: saw a surge around 03:42 UTC. Symptoms: repeated client retries + large batch embedding calls. Customer reported timeouts then retried.

billing-bot: alert: account=novameds threshold=4x baseline triggered at 4132117900 1h burn=2.8M tokens (24h) baseline=200k 1 est overage $620/day if sustained.

maya_fin: rough ask: what buffer do you want to recommend? Finance prefers single message w/ justification.

zoe_cs: thinking a $900 one-time buffer to cover immediate overage while we implement fixes. We'll present as "preemptive buffer" in QBR to avoid sticker shock during onboarding.

devon_engineer: mitigation plan: 1) server-side request coalescing for duplicate embed requests (can ship in 12h) 2) suggest client update to exponential backoff (they're on old SDK) 3) enable a model-fallback to a cheaper embed variant for bulk jobs.

arun_ops: also recommend a short TTL on large KV caches so we don't keep hot prefixes longer than needed for onboarding. Low-risk change.

mike_support: logs show this pattern:
```
2026-03-21T03:42:11Z WARN timeout id=nm_221 retry=1
2026-03-21T03:42:12Z RETRY id=nm_221 retry=2
2026-03-21T03:42:13Z RETRY id=nm_221 retry=3
2026-03-21T03:42:14Z WARN embed_batch size=120 payload_mb=4.2
```

zoe_cs: For the QBR slide we want: what happened, mitigation timeline, projected spend after changes, and what we did to prevent recurrence. Can we get a short projected spend number after mitigations?

devon_engineer: projection: after coalescing + backoff + fallback, estimate ~180k/day (customer workload normalizes).

maya_fin: cool. Draft ask text for finance approval please. I'll sign off if phrasing and numbers are clear.

zoe_cs: draft below. Feedback welcome.

--- draft buffer ask ---
Account: NovaMeds (acct_nm221)
Issue: Onboarding produced an unexpected token spike: ~2.8M tokens in 24h vs baseline ~200k. Root cause: client retries combined with large embed batches during a transient timeout window.
Request: One-time preemptive credit $900 to cover ~72h of excess while mitigations roll out.
Mitigations: server-side request coalescing (ETA 12h), client SDK backoff guidance (customer ETA 48h), model-fallback for bulk embed jobs (rollout 24h).
Projected spend post-mitigation: ~180k tokens/day.
Business rationale: maintain onboarding momentum and avoid surprise billing churn; include resolution steps in QBR to rebuild trust.
--- end draft ---

maya_fin: looks reasonable. Approve $900 contingent on a short exec summary (one paragraph) and the commit to patch adoption from the customer.

zoe_cs: will add exec summary and ping customer for SDK commit before we grant.

arun_ops: suggested alert rule you can paste into their org rule set (uses 6h rolling avg):
```
alert: novameds_tokens_rolling
expr: avg_over_time(sum(rate(redwood_tokens_total{account="novameds"}[5m]))[6h:5m]) > (baseline_tokens_per_hour * 6)
for: 30m
annotations:
  summary: "NovaMeds sustained tokens > 6x baseline (6h)"
```
Change baseline_tokens_per_hour to their 7d rolling average.

mike_support: also enabling an in-console banner and a soft quota cap at 5x baseline while we triage.

billing-bot: creating #cs-novameds-spend for 48h and posting daily digest.

zoe_cs: timeline: I'll finish exec summary + send to @maya_fin by 15:00 PT. QBR is Wed so need customer commit before then.

maya_fin: I'll review by 16:00 PT. If approved, finance will pre-authorize immediate credit on acceptance.

zoe_cs: thanks team. I'll update here after customer accept and when coalescing is live.
